gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Reading here feels crisp and contemporary, with lowercase that climbs high and curves that turn without any ink pooling. Noto Sans Medefaidrin sits under Wallpoet, whose bold letters let paper show between them.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikak: Wallpoet leaves a line of paper showing between its bold letters for a commanding look. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui stays modern and clean, with daylight in every curve, so Wallpoet belongs on big, short headings.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-mono: Generously spaced letters never bump together here, and the wide curve openings make words look sturdy and large. Noto Sans Mono handles the quiet reading work, while Wallpoet does the bold, commanding shouting.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-mro: Words look dense through the middle, with wide entrances into each letter, which gives Noto Sans Mro a modern, professional feel. Give Wallpoet the biggest sizes on the page.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Loud meets lofty: bold, commanding Wallpoet leads Noto Sans Nabataean, whose lowercase stands almost cap-high. And the high-reaching lowercase in both is the thread that ties them together.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-newa: Wallpoet leaves a line of paper showing between its bold letters for a commanding look. But Noto Sans Newa opens the lowercase e wide, and that clear mouth is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Modern through and through, Noto Sans Nushu has towering lowercase. Its terminals sit far from the stroke body, so paragraphs of text move along openly beneath the bold, commanding Wallpoet.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Wide gaps in the e and bodies this big make Noto Sans Ogham look bold and clean. Wallpoet handles the shouting; the text face handles the reading.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-old-north-a: Wallpoet is bold and commanding, tracing a smooth path around every bend. But Noto Sans Old North Arabian does the approachable reading, with a dense lowercase band and outward-pointing terminals.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-old-persian: Big, bold, and see-through between letters: that's Wallpoet. Save it for large, brief headings, and let Noto Sans Old Persian handle the text with open counters that breathe into the white space.
